reason: The two largest added charts (2 triangles each; added tris [4313,4403] dup of fixed [1378,1379] and [4317,4407] dup of [1386,1387]; UV bbox ~0.212x0.068 and 0.215x0.068; world ~0.214m x 0.681m planar panels; together 77% of added UV area) do not fit into free space of the fixed UV2 at baseline density, even with 90-degree rotations and zero padding. Fitting them requires uniform shrink to <=0.79 (zero padding, edge contact only) and 0.70/0.60/0.50 at 0.0039/0.0078/0.0117 normalized margin, i.e. density below fixed P25 (0.2532) and texel area 62%..25% of baseline. acceptanceThresholdUsedByCloud: candidate only if all 107 charts fit with margin >0 at scale >=0.80 (density >= fixed P25 ~0.253, texel area >=64%); this threshold is Cloud proposal, not an approved target

density.definition: sqrt(|UV area|/world area), world via native localToWorld (UV units per world metre)

methods: exact Sutherland-Hodgman clipping for overlap (tools/uvgeom.py, qa_baseline.py); edge contact = 0 area and 0 padding
placement search: conservative raster N=2048 (+1px dilation of fixed and chart, +1.5px EDT slack), FFT correlation fit test, rotations 0/90/180/270, no mirroring, no scaling (pack_uv2.py)
shrink probe: uniform scale about chart centroid for the 2 largest charts placed first, step 0.025 (0.01 at margin 0), then remaining 105 at scale 1 (scale_probe.py)
limitations: raster search is conservative: the true maximum scale may be higher by about 2px/2048 relative to chart height 0.068 (~+0.03 scale); does not change the HOLD at any positive margin under the stated threshold
arbitrary-angle rotation not tried (free gaps are thin horizontal/vertical bands ~0.03-0.04 UV; a 0.215 x 0.068 chart cannot fit diagonally either - not formally proven)
